115-F. Right to vote.—

—   (1) Every person whose name is in the list of voters relating 
to a ward of Panchayat shall, subject to the other provisions of the Act, be entitled to vote 
at any election which takes place in that Panchayat territorial Constituency. 
(2) No person shall vote at any election under this Act in more than one Panchayat 
territorial Constituency or more than one in the same Panchayat territorial Constituency.
